source_text.body:
Run crypto futures trades with an agent under trader-set rules
A trader connected OpenClaw to OpenAlgo and a crypto futures exchange; it made 47 trades, 4 manually overridden including a rogue ETH long, then execution permission was removed.
·
Nov 10, 2026
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
The trader ran OpenClaw on a Mac Mini M4, with OpenAlgo handling order placement and position management on live exchange feeds. They wrote their momentum strategy as plain-language instructions. Stop losses and a daily loss kill switch sat outside the agent. Exchange keys went through the broker's official system. Setup took about an hour. The trader monitored throughout and overrode some trades.
How it went
Over 14 days: +4.8% net, 47 trades, 57% win rate, -6.2% max drawdown, 4 manual overrides. A skill update changed how a condition was read, producing the rogue ETH long. The trader then limited the agent to research and signals.
Worth knowing
Keep stop losses and kill switches outside the agent, and audit third-party skills. One ClawHub skill was sending unauthorised outbound calls, so the trader revoked and regenerated the API keys.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Connect to my [broker or exchange] account in paper trading mode and trade [instrument] only under these rules: max position size [amount], max loss per trade [percent], allowed hours [hours], no new positions after [daily loss limit]. Before placing any order, show me the order details and wait for my yes. At the end of each day, send me a log of every trade and any rule you came close to breaking.
Original source: https://www.mexc.com/it-IT/news/880926
